svg.title: DIA-405 · Hurry Up and Wait
svg.desc: Three rows read from top to bottom. At the top, a ticket rail drawn to scale: twenty tickets stand for the work finished on teams that use AI little, and the rail runs on to thirty-three for teams that use it heavily, 66.2 percent more. In the middle, the pass: plates are piled up in front of a gate that lets one through at a time, with a note that changes sat in review more than five times as long, and one plate drawn in rust is coming back from the table, for 57.9 percent more incidents a month. At the bottom, plates going out the door on the same scale of twenty: seventeen and two thirds are solid and the rest are dashed outlines in rust, 11.7 percent fewer deployments a week. Vendor telemetry comparing teams, not a randomized trial.
svg.text: SAME MENU, DIFFERENT KITCHEN · SECTION 5 · THE PASS
Work finished where AI is used little: 20 tickets on the rail.
Out the door: deployments a week, on the same scale of 20.
DIA-405 · Teams using AI heavily finished 66.2% more work, deployed 11.7% less often, and had 57.9% more incidents a month.
